invariants.text: A department must have at least one employee assigned to it.
An employee must belong to exactly one department.
An employee's email must be unique across all employees.
An employee's first name and last name together must uniquely identify the employee.
Department.department_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Employee.department_id must reference an existing Department.department_id
Employee.employee_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
The department name must be unique across all departments.
